findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, verify_email, chat_gpt_oss_120b, extract_data, watch_field, read_url · Private data: url_to_markdown, file_to_markdown, verify_email, dns_lookup, chat_gpt_oss_120b, chat_qwen3_30b, company_lei, watch_field, read_url, watch_status, stop_watch · Public sink: verify_email, watch_field · Destructive: verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, verify_email, chat_gpt_oss_120b, extract_data, watch_field, read_url · Private data: url_to_markdown, file_to_markdown, verify_email, dns_lookup, chat_gpt_oss_120b, chat_qwen3_30b, company_lei, watch_field, read_url, watch_status, stop_watch · Public sink: verify_email, watch_field · Destructive: verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
